note: Bare 你做什么？ is abrupt/ambiguous (reads as 'What do you do?' or a confrontational 'What are you doing?!'); the natural forms already exist as p016 你在做什么 and p081 你想做什么.
Intentional silly line; grammatical (个 is colloquially fine for 电脑, 台 would be more formal). Keep only if the joke is intended.
我想看见你 is unnatural (看见 is a result verb, 'catch sight of'); natives say 我想见你 (见 alone is not HSK1) or 我想看看你.
